en.headline: Police arrest man, 41, after failed breath test in San Po Kong
en.dek: Officers stopped an unsteady private car near Choi Hung Road late on Wednesday and bailed the driver.
body: Police arrested a 41-year-old man on suspicion of drink-driving after stopping a private car near San Po Kong late on Wednesday, Sing Tao Daily reported.

Officers from the East Kowloon traffic unit had set up a roadblock near the junction of Prince Edward Road East and Choi Hung Road at about 11pm, the paper said. A private car with a personalised registration approached unsteadily and was stopped. Officers found the driver smelled of alcohol and he failed a breath test.

He was arrested on suspicion of drink-driving and later released on bail, pending further inquiries. He is due to report to a police station later this month, according to the report. Sing Tao Daily did not give a numerical reading from the test.

zh.headline: 新蒲崗私家車行車不穩 41歲司機酒測不合格被捕
zh.dek: 東九龍交通部周三深夜在彩虹道路障截停一輛自訂車牌私家車，司機保釋候查。
body: 《星島日報》報道，警方周三深夜在新蒲崗一帶截停一輛行車不穩的私家車，拘捕一名41歲男子，涉嫌酒後駕駛。
報道指，東九龍總區交通部人員約晚上11時在太子道東與彩虹道交界附近設置路障，發現一輛掛自訂車牌的私家車駛近時左右搖晃，遂截停調查。警員接觸司機時發現他身上有酒味，要求他接受酒精呼氣測試，他未能通過。
該名司機涉嫌酒後駕駛被捕，調查後獲准保釋，須於本月下旬返回警署報到。報道沒有公布呼氣測試的數值。
